nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What are electronic healthcare devices (EHDs) considered as compared to conventional healthcare equipment?
nodes.answer: EHDs are considered alternative solutions to conventional healthcare equipment, offering reliable diagnostics, self-monitoring capabilities, improved patient comfort, and less invasive procedures.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Good health and well-being|Digital health and telemedicine|Digital health records_qna_001
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: How is an electronic healthcare device (EHD) defined in the context of the paragraph?
nodes.answer: An electronic healthcare device (EHD) is defined as a device that provides clinical provision of direct patient care.
